general_information.Syllabus Name: Celebrities Management_Quản lý người nổi tiếng
general_information.Learning-Teaching Method: Lecture, Discussions, Tutorials, Group work, Practice, Seminar
general_information.Description: This course will cover the definition and history of the "celebrity" concept, as well as the influence of celebrities on relevant fields of art, culture, and society in general. Taking an inter-disciplinary approach, and integrating theory with practice, this course equips students with the celebrity culture knowledge and skills to effectively manage the celebrities within both international and Vietnamese contexts.
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination 2. Actively participate in class activities 3. Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class 4. Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose 5. Read the textbook in advance 6. Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

description: This course will cover the definition and history of the "celebrity" concept, as well as the influence of celebrities on relevant fields of art, culture, and society in general. Taking an inter-disciplinary approach, and integrating theory with practice, this course equips students with the celebrity culture knowledge and skills to effectively manage the celebrities within both international and Vietnamese contexts.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Demonstrate an understanding of the concepts, theories and practice of celebrity management
Analyse and develop strategies for celebrity promotion using the theories, models and methods of celebrity management
Gain the capacity to identify and handle issues and crises relating to celebrity
Develop a critical attitude towards celebrity management
Identify and apply ethical standards of practice when dealing with celebrity management issues
Skills in analysis and problem solving; proficient in presentation and teamwork skills

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Test the acquainted knowledge which student obtained in the delivered chapters (Chapter 1 - Chapter 4)
assessments.Grading Guide: Complete an individual 2000-word essay (+/- 10% allowed, not including the reference list) to analyse how an East Asian/Southeast Asian celebrity has been promoted in the world. Students will be the one to choose the case study to analyse. Students will need to examine a range of sources including celebrity management company's organisational documents and materials (e.g. annual reports, website), media (e.g. news coverage, social media platforms) and academic literature (e.g. journal articles, books). Based on the analysis, students will need to draw key learnings and give strategic recommendations for promoting East Asian/Southeast Asian celebrities internationally in the near future. Note: The detailed marking criteria for this assessment will be provided by the lecturer. The lecturer, through class discussion, is expected to answer student's questions about what they are not sure. The lecturer will summarise the key points and emphasize what students have to keep in mind while writing this essay.
assessments.Note: Assignment Release: week 2 Submission Deadline: week 5

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Test the acquainted knowledge which student obtained in the delivered chapters (Chapter 1 - Chapter 6)
assessments.Grading Guide: Students work in groups (from 4 to 6 members) to create one communications plan in order to promote a Vietnamese celebrity. The plan must showcase all knowledge the students have gained in the class, as well as the capacity to practise with and apply learnt knowledge to a real-world case of your choosing. Report (20%): The structure of the report will be revealed and modified during the class based on the celebrity the students choose to promote. Presentation + Q&A (10%): For the 20-minute presentation, you are required to showcase all of your key points mentioned in your report in front of your classmates. Your presentation should showcase the potential of your plan by using the right strategies, content and media platforms. After each presentation, there will be a 15-minute Q&A session with lecturer and other groups. Notes: Further details of the communication plan will be provided in class. The detailed marking criteria for this assessment will be provided by the lecturer.
assessments.Note: Assignment Release: week 2 Submission Deadline & Presentation: week 7

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Test the acquainted knowledge which student obtained in the delivered chapters (Chapter 5 - Chapter 8)
assessments.Grading Guide: Report (10%) + Press Release (10%) Students work in groups (from 4 to 6 members) to select one Vietnamese celebrity's crisis, then propose a communications strategy to urgently respond to that crisis, as well as prepare a press release based on your scenario. Presentation + Q&A (10%): For the 15-minute presentation, you are required to showcase all of your key points mentioned in your report in front of your classmates. After each presentation, there will be a 15-minute Q&A session with lecturer and other groups. Notes: Further details of the assignment will be discussed in class. The detailed marking criteria for this assessment will be provided by the lecturer.
assessments.Note: Assignment Release: week 5 Submission Deadline & Presentation: week 10

assessments.Grading Guide: Participation grade will be given based on students' attendance, students' attitude, preparation, contribution of discussions

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: The questions/ exercises will cover the lectures, class discussions, activities, exercises, and textbook.
assessments.Grading Guide: Not allow to use any document/information in any form in exam room
